name: ACS (Independent)
summary: Leading Methodist independent school with IB Diploma and IP options.
body:
ACS (Independent) offers IP and IB Diploma routes within the local independent sector. Popular among families eligible for local schools who still want IB. Distinct from ACS International — confirm which ACS entity you mean in conversations. Ask how orientation week half-days and parent briefings are scheduled for dual-career households, and whether PH observance matches the campus calendar.

The Dover Road campus sits in the Holland-Bukit Timah school belt, so housing nearby trades at a premium. Do not confuse it with ACS International further south; admissions offices, fees, and curricula differ. Check whether your target entry point is IP, IB, or both before shortlisting.
